:::{#exr-ppv-ratio-form}
#### PPV in terms of two ratios

Rewrite the expression for the positive predictive value from @exr-ppv-bayes
so that the sensitivity, specificity, and prevalence appear only through
the ratio $\frac{1 - \text{spec}}{\text{sens}}$
of the false positive rate to the sensitivity
and the ratio $\frac{1 - \text{prev}}{\text{prev}}$
of non-diseased to diseased people in the population.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-ppv-ratio-form}

Write $a \eqdef \text{sens} \cd \text{prev}$
and $b \eqdef \paren{1 - \text{spec}} \cd \paren{1 - \text{prev}}$,
so that @exr-ppv-bayes reads $\text{PPV} = \frac{a}{a + b}$,
with $a > 0$ whenever the sensitivity and prevalence are positive.
Then:

$$
\ba
\text{PPV}
&= \frac{a}{a + b}
&& \text{(PPV from Bayes' theorem)} \\
&= \frac{1}{\paren{\frac{a + b}{a}}}
&& \text{(a fraction equals one over its reciprocal, since } a > 0 \text{)} \\
&= \frac{1}{\frac{a}{a} + \frac{b}{a}}
&& \text{(split the fraction over the sum in its numerator)} \\
&= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{b}{a}}
&& \text{(} \tfrac{a}{a} = 1 \text{)} \\
&= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{\paren{1 - \text{spec}} \cd \paren{1 - \text{prev}}}{\text{sens} \cd \text{prev}}}
&& \text{(substitute the definitions of } a \text{ and } b \text{)} \\
&= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{1 - \text{spec}}{\text{sens}} \cd \frac{1 - \text{prev}}{\text{prev}}}
&& \text{(a quotient of products is the product of the quotients)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-ppv-ratio-form-exr}

:::
